releaseNotes: Fixed Stock & Medicine Accuracy: Isolated inventory queries strictly by the selected MR's assigned Headquarters depot, eliminating cross-HQ stock summation errors
Full 17-Medicine Catalog Visibility: All company products are now visible during task creation with accurate live stock pills (In Stock, Low Stock, or Out of Stock) and filter toggles
Product Detailing Focus Sync: Selected focus medicines are now saved on task assignment and prominently highlighted on the MR mobile task card
Dynamic In-App Medicine Chips: Real-time depot stock indicators and exact medicine matching in the duty order recording screen
